threat_event: Attacker reaches field SCADA through internet-exposed well pad modems and shuts in production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 120 cellular modems with public IP addresses; no OT monitoring
existing_controls: Modem passwords changed in 2025; local safety systems
treatment_plan: Private APN for all modems; OT monitoring at the POC (POAM-019)
owner: Gas Production SCADA and automation manager

threat_event: Attacker uses SYS-G4 standing access to reach the POC
threat_source: External attacker with Engineering Services credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineering Services accounts can reach the POC jump hosts without a business need
existing_controls: MFA at the gateway; session recording
treatment_plan: Remove all Engineering Services access to the POC except named project accounts (POAM-001)
owner: Gas Production SCADA and automation manager

threat_event: Shared SCADA accounts hide who made a change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: POC consoles and RTU engineering tools use shared accounts
existing_controls: Physical access to the POC controlled
treatment_plan: Named accounts on consoles and engineering tools (POAM-018)
owner: Gas Production SCADA and automation manager

threat_event: Unsupported RTUs exploited or fail without spares
owner: Gas Production SCADA and automation manager

threat_event: Staff follow 2023 division standards that conflict with group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Division supplement not aligned since 2023 (OT not addressed; 90-day log retention; next-day termination)
existing_controls: Group policy governs where they conflict
owner: Gas Production security and compliance lead

threat_event: POC SCADA cannot be restored after ransomware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monthly offline copy only; restore not tested
treatment_plan: Weekly offline copies; restore test each quarter
owner: Gas Production SCADA and automation manager

threat_event: Compressor station control altered to cause an unsafe condition
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Local safety systems are independent, but PLC programs are not integrity-checked

threat_event: SCADA integrator software update carries malicious code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator updates installed without integrity checks
existing_controls: Updates tested at the POC lab
treatment_plan: Hash verification and signed packages (group OT vendor process)
owner: Gas Production SCADA and automation manager

threat_event: Ransomware on Gas Production business systems halts accounting and nominations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Business systems on the corporate network; nominations workstation on the same segment
treatment_plan: Isolate the nominations workstation; restore test of SYS-N2

threat_event: No detection of intrusion in field networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No sensors; RTU logs not collected
treatment_plan: Passive sensor at the POC aggregation point feeding the group SOC

threat_event: Royalty owner SSNs and bank accounts stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 48,000 owner records; exports emailed to the bank
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (each state where owners reside; Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)
treatment_plan: Secure file transfer to the bank; access review

threat_event: Nominations cannot be made when SYS-N2 is down
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One workstation path to pipeline portals
existing_controls: Manual nominations by phone with pipelines
treatment_plan: Second standalone nominations workstation at another office
owner: Gas Production vice president of marketing
